method.improvement: Validation-gated pairwise interaction features; sigmoid probability calibration
method.candidate_selection: Retain interaction candidate only when selection-partition ROC AUC beats original blend; otherwise original model remains
method.calibration: Platt sigmoid fitted on calibration partition only; retained only if selection-partition Brier error improves
method.threshold_selection: Maximum F1 on separate validation selection partition
method.authentication_policy_selection: Largest calibrated challenge threshold meeting >=80% suspicious detection on selection partition, minimizing legitimate friction; high cutoff remains 0.7

baseline.name: Paper blend, raw probabilities, 0.5 classification threshold

improved.name: Validation-selected blend + calibrated probabilities + conservative challenge policy

rejected_policy_ablation.name: Calibrated probability with unchanged paper 0.3/0.7 cutoffs
rejected_policy_ablation.reason: Calibration reduced probabilities; unchanged cutoffs lose suspicious challenge recall, so this policy is not deployed.

majority_baseline.name: Always predict legitimate
majority_baseline.interpretation: Imbalanced-label accuracy alone is misleading; this baseline detects no suspicious events.

static_auth_baseline.name: Valid credential always directly allowed
static_auth_baseline.interpretation: Conceptual policy baseline assumes credentials already passed, with no context challenge.

latency.scope: Single-row model inference, local CPU, excludes HTTP and model training

limitations: Synthetic labels measure this generator, not real-world credential theft detection.
The paper reports projected benchmarks; these are fresh empirical synthetic measurements.
Calibration reduces probability error; any accuracy/recall tradeoff is reported without suppressing regressions.
Client-supplied context is suitable for a local demo; production must derive device, network and behavioral signals server-side.
No automatic retraining from votes: approval labels are not ground-truth malicious-login labels.
Authentication challenge cutoff is validation-tuned for >=80% suspicious detection; evaluation maximum-F1 classification threshold is separate.
Validation recall target is not a guarantee of held-out or real-world detection.

nlp.name: Validation-tuned TF-IDF + Naive Bayes
nlp.split: Disjoint template groups; random identifiers unique across splits

method.candidate: Fixed C=0.8 balanced logistic regression over word and character TF-IDF
method.threshold_selection: Maximum macro F1 on validation only
method.model_selection: Candidate must improve validation macro F1 without increasing legitimate flag rate relative to validation-tuned baseline

nlp.limitation: Exploratory reanalysis of the original benchmark, whose template outcomes were already reported. Only two template groups per label are held out; no claim of a new untouched language test set. Selection uses validation, not test outcomes. Handwritten flags and runtime abstentions are excluded from binary classifier scores. No BERT result is claimed.
